title: When Corpus Coverage Matters More Than Model Choice: An English-Uzbek Low-Resource RAG Evaluation Dataset
description: Auxiliary draft metadata for a 400-row English-Uzbek retrieval-only evaluation candidate. The public candidate excludes gold_answer, reference_answer, answer, context, excerpt, and source-text fields while full QA release clearance is pending.

planned_full_qa_release.note: Answer/reference fields are excluded from the public candidate until source-derived text is manually cleared.

limitations: Retrieval-only candidate; not a full generated-answer quality benchmark.
Does not support answer correctness, faithfulness, or reference-answer metrics without separately cleared references.
Full raw corpora, indexes, and HPC run artifacts are not included in this release folder.
English supplementation results are retracted and should not be cited.
